# Experten om Anthropic: Brutalt stor notering

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this episode, Ernst & Young's IPO head Andreas Dahlhäll reviews the IPO market so far this year. Q3 2026 was strong globally, with 87 IPOs worth about $96bn (+84% y/y), led by US tech and life science and by Chinese tech and energy listings. The large Anthropic IPO, valued at a reported $1-2 trillion, is expected to boost appetite further. Sweden and the Nordics are much cooler: transaction value is down about 80% and most of the large 2025 listings have done poorly (Verisure about -40%, while Noba is about +30%). The guest expects few Swedish IPOs in Q4 and is hopeful that companies are preparing to list in 2027.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ VSURE — Verisure | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The guest (EY IPO head) says Verisure has not done well since its IPO and describes it as down about 40%, which is weighing on the Swedish IPO climate.

#### Reasoning

The guest is describing performance, not recommending the stock. The weak trading since listing and the damage to international investors' view of Swedish IPOs point to negative sentiment. This is a weak signal: no explicit sell call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share recovers to its IPO price
- if earnings re-rate the stock

> *"Även Verisure noterades ju för lite drygt ett år sedan. Har inte gått särskilt bra på börsen."*

---

### 🟠 NOBA — Noba | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The guest names Noba as the only 2025 IPO trading clearly above its listing price, up about 30%.

#### Reasoning

The guest only states past performance relative to the IPO price and gives no forward view. Relative strength against its weak 2025 IPO peers makes Noba worth watching, but there is no buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise
- if relative strength against the 2025 IPO class reverses

> *"Det är väl egentligen Noba som är upp ungefär 30% från sin introduktionskurs."*
